subject: Add getter in config for the default value (#547)
reason: The change adds an internal GetDefaultValue() accessor to the vmsdk config classes that no production code in valkey-search calls (only the new unit test uses it), fixes a comment, and reworks String::FromString to record the default — a path reachable only when a string-typed module config is set from module arguments, and valkey-search registers no string config anywhere in src/ (all its configs are Number, Boolean or Enum, whose FromString and CONFIG GET/SET paths are unchanged).
